title: SG-6.4.3 · Wire approve, retry and reject handlers into AdminApp's ExecutionPanel
summary: AdminApp passes onApprove, onRetry and onReject to ExecutionPanel; each calls its client function, reloads and shows errors
description: Context: ExecutionPanel already accepts onApprove, onRetry, onReject and actionError props. The client already exports approveExecution, retryExecution and rejectExecution. AdminApp renders ExecutionPanel without any handlers, so the buttons never appear. Desired behavior: each handler calls the matching client function with the admin token and execution id, reloads Round, contributions and execution afterwards, and shows an error message on failure. Why: the admin can then act on executions from the console.
acceptance_criteria: Given an AWAITING_APPROVAL execution, when the admin clicks Approve or Reject, then the matching client endpoint is called with the id and the Bearer token, and the data reloads
Given a FAILED execution, when the admin clicks Retry, then the retry endpoint is called and the data reloads
Given an action endpoint answers an error, when the admin clicks the button, then an error message is shown in the Execution region

out_of_scope: Backend changes, including a reject route

technical_constraints: UI only; reuse approveExecution, retryExecution, rejectExecution from api/client.ts
Reload through the existing reloads counter
definition_of_done: All requirements, units and evidence complete
